child_list.content: The Spring Festival
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
The Spring Festival is also called the Lunar New Year. Before the Spring Festival, people clean their houses and put the spring couplets on their doors. On the eve of the Spring Festival, all the members get together and have a big dinner. After the dinner, the children can set off fireworks. On the first day of the New Year, the children wear new clothes and get some money from their parents. And they always say

“Happy New Year” to each other.

elements.content:

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

child_list.content: 春节
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 春节也被称作农历新年。春节前，人们打扫房屋，张贴对联。除夕夜，全家人聚集在一起吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。吃完饭，孩子们放烟花。新年的第一天，孩子们穿着新衣服，并且拿到了父母给的压岁钱。他们互相说着“新年快乐”。
child_list.name: 文本框

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
